fixtureTierDefinitions.golden-exact-corpus: Trusted full-page exact fixture that may gate normal corpus runs.
fixtureTierDefinitions.focused-exact-corpus: Trusted compact or component-focused exact fixture that gates one narrow behavior family without claiming full-page live-site breadth.
fixtureTierDefinitions.partial-corpus: Fixture with documented reliable slices, but not a full-page exact gate.
fixtureTierDefinitions.candidate-parked-corpus: Useful full-page evidence with unresolved windows or evidence gaps; runnable but not an exact gate.
fixtureTierDefinitions.artifact-archive: Evidence kept for investigation but not used for corpus gating.

fixtureTierMigration.method: Backfilled fixtureTier from existing refinement status. Exact refined/trusted entries became golden-exact-corpus, partial entries became partial-corpus, candidate entries became candidate-parked-corpus, and skip entries became artifact-archive.
fixtureTierMigration.note: This migration records the current tier structure without claiming a full duplicate-coverage audit for legacy fixtures. Future Phase E receipts must record uniqueCoverage and existingCoverageChecked before adding new full-page fixtures.

fixtureCuration.scope: First-pass corpus curation over all current manifest entries.
fixtureCuration.method: Grouped fixtures by site family and behavior coverage, marked exact focused examples separately from full-page golden fixtures, and recorded overlap/pruning recommendations without deleting historical evidence.
fixtureCuration.nextAudit: Review high-overlap Sky and legacy no-step exact fixtures after the next full corpus timing report; replace duplicate full-page gates with focused repros where the same engine rule is already protected.
